records.part: Replacement scale system for Northbound and Southbound Scale 2 at Punta Gorda Weigh Stations
records.reason: The existing computer systems for the scales were developed by Mettler Toledo and are compatible with the existing 7541 scales throughout the state.

records.part: Existing scales throughout the state requiring compatible replacement parts
records.reason: The new scale system must remain compatible with the existing 7541 scales throughout the state which further reduces maintenance costs by ensuring FDOT has the spare parts necessary to repair the scales.

records.part: Weigh-In-Motion (WIM) system software enabling auto calibration, center of gravity assessment, auto release and WIM record verification
records.reason: Mettler Toledo has exclusive copyright to the software, and there are no resellers for the Scale Management software/hardware integration.
